review.method: offline frame extraction and hand-reviewed contact sheets
review.privacy: Raw frames remain ignored because they contain account and conversation content. This manifest stores only sanitized product-state descriptions.

rendererFindings.source: reviewed REA inventory and selected local bundle modules
rendererFindings.finding: Mermaid fences use Mermaid 11.16.0, a 240px minimum preview, loading and failure states, hover actions for source/copy/download, and an expandable full-size viewer.

rendererFindings.source: reviewed REA inventory and selected local bundle modules
rendererFindings.finding: The transcript considers the viewport pinned within 24 CSS pixels of the bottom, stops following after deliberate upward navigation, and exposes an accessible Scroll to bottom control while displaced.

rendererFindings.source: recording frames at 00:10, 02:32, 02:36, and 02:50 plus reviewed local workspace modules
rendererFindings.finding: Opening a file turns the right side into a persistent split workspace rather than a narrow overlay. It combines a breadcrumb editor, line-numbered highlighted source, changed/all-files trees, loading and retry states, and file actions while the conversation remains visible.

rendererFindings.source: reviewed REA inventory and local highlight-code/shiki provider modules
rendererFindings.finding: The product uses registered syntax grammars for fenced code and a worker-backed Shiki provider for editor surfaces; code blocks expose language and copy chrome rather than plain preformatted text.

rendererFindings.source: reviewed app-server v2 ThreadItem schema and recording frame at 02:10
rendererFindings.finding: imageView and imageGeneration are first-class thread items. Viewed images appear as expandable activity with a thumbnail and open into a dedicated image preview with loading, failure, download, and zoom states.
